suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(edgeR) # differential gene expression using neg.bin stats
  library(pheatmap)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble) # for plotting (features*samples) heatmaps
})

Downloading the data

url <- "https://ethz-ins.org/content/mouse_mm38_hippocampus.peakCounts.SE.rds"
dest <- "mouse_mm38_hippocampus.peakCounts.SE.rds"

if (!file.exists(dest)) {
  download.file(url, dest, mode = "wb")
}

se <- readRDS(dest)
dim(se)
## [1] 20660    12
assay_names <- assayNames(se)
assay_names
## [1] "counts"
# Usually the count matrix is in the first assay
counts <- assay(se)

# Sample metadata
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
colnames(cd)
## [1] "depth"
head(cd)
##                                  depth
## Control_female_GSM6041841.bam 73170149
## Control_female_GSM6041842.bam 93995034
## Control_female_GSM6041843.bam 40167775
## Control_male_GSM6041844.bam   70491005
## Control_male_GSM6041845.bam   84985977
## Control_male_GSM6041846.bam   90317960
# CHANGE THESE if needed after inspecting colData(se)
sample_names <- colnames(counts)

cd$condition <- sub("_.*", "", sample_names)
cd$sex <- sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", sample_names)

stress_col <- "condition"
sex_col <- "sex"

head(cd)
##                                  depth condition    sex
## Control_female_GSM6041841.bam 73170149   Control female
## Control_female_GSM6041842.bam 93995034   Control female
## Control_female_GSM6041843.bam 40167775   Control female
## Control_male_GSM6041844.bam   70491005   Control   male
## Control_male_GSM6041845.bam   84985977   Control   male
## Control_male_GSM6041846.bam   90317960   Control   male
stress_col
## [1] "condition"
sex_col
## [1] "sex"
stopifnot(!is.null(stress_col), !is.null(sex_col))

# Make factors
cd[[stress_col]] <- factor(cd[[stress_col]])
cd[[sex_col]] <- factor(cd[[sex_col]])

# Check levels
levels(cd[[stress_col]])
## [1] "Control" "FSS"
levels(cd[[sex_col]])
## [1] "female" "male"
y <- DGEList(counts = counts, samples = cd)

# Default normalization requested in the assignment
y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
# stress comparison: FSS vs Control

control_level <- "Control"

cd$stress2 <- relevel(cd[[stress_col]], ref = control_level)

design_stress <- model.matrix(~ stress2, data = cd)
design_stress
##                               (Intercept) stress2FSS
## Control_female_GSM6041841.bam           1          0
## Control_female_GSM6041842.bam           1          0
## Control_female_GSM6041843.bam           1          0
## Control_male_GSM6041844.bam             1          0
## Control_male_GSM6041845.bam             1          0
## Control_male_GSM6041846.bam             1          0
## FSS_female_GSM6041853.bam               1          1
## FSS_female_GSM6041854.bam               1          1
## FSS_female_GSM6041855.bam               1          1
## FSS_male_GSM6041856.bam                 1          1
## FSS_male_GSM6041857.bam                 1          1
## FSS_male_GSM6041858.bam                 1          1
## attr(,"assign")
## [1] 0 1
## attr(,"contrasts")
## attr(,"contrasts")$stress2
## [1] "contr.treatment"
y_stress <- estimateDisp(y, design_stress)
fit_stress <- glmQLFit(y_stress, design_stress)

qlf_stress <- glmQLFTest(fit_stress, coef = 2)

res_stress <- topTags(qlf_stress, n = Inf)$table
res_stress <- tibble::rownames_to_column(res_stress, "peak_id")

top10_stress <- res_stress %>%
  arrange(PValue) %>%
  slice(1:10)

top10_stress
##    peak_id     logFC   logCPM        F       PValue       FDR
## 1    15757  2.951988 5.569178 24.78401 5.406582e-05 0.2821028
## 2    14137 -5.551957 7.660126 19.04590 2.457484e-04 0.2821028
## 3    19358 -5.296031 6.886896 18.20176 3.027612e-04 0.2821028
## 4     8714 -4.821148 8.215976 18.12178 3.285444e-04 0.2821028
## 5     2118 -5.985600 8.519146 18.02376 3.335824e-04 0.2821028
## 6    12264 -4.769081 5.724001 17.63549 3.341412e-04 0.2821028
## 7    17466 -3.848544 3.762903 16.47296 3.838410e-04 0.2821028
## 8      869 -4.348061 6.851766 17.37070 4.024893e-04 0.2821028
## 9     4967  2.850292 4.137813 16.86048 4.036248e-04 0.2821028
## 10    3430 -4.279221 7.507119 17.36206 4.084654e-04 0.2821028
logcpm <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

mat_stress <- logcpm[top10_stress$peak_id, , drop = FALSE]

anno_col_stress <- cd[, c(stress_col, sex_col), drop = FALSE]
rownames(anno_col_stress) <- colnames(mat_stress)

pheatmap(
  mat_stress,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = anno_col_stress,
  main = "Top 10 stress-associated regions"
)

# set reference levels manually
female_level <- "female"
male_level <- "male"

# make sure they are factors
cd[[sex_col]] <- factor(cd[[sex_col]])
cd[[stress_col]] <- factor(cd[[stress_col]])

# relevel so female is baseline
cd$sex2 <- relevel(cd[[sex_col]], ref = female_level)

# design matrix
design_sex <- model.matrix(~ sex2, data = cd)
design_sex
##                               (Intercept) sex2male
## Control_female_GSM6041841.bam           1        0
## Control_female_GSM6041842.bam           1        0
## Control_female_GSM6041843.bam           1        0
## Control_male_GSM6041844.bam             1        1
## Control_male_GSM6041845.bam             1        1
## Control_male_GSM6041846.bam             1        1
## FSS_female_GSM6041853.bam               1        0
## FSS_female_GSM6041854.bam               1        0
## FSS_female_GSM6041855.bam               1        0
## FSS_male_GSM6041856.bam                 1        1
## FSS_male_GSM6041857.bam                 1        1
## FSS_male_GSM6041858.bam                 1        1
## attr(,"assign")
## [1] 0 1
## attr(,"contrasts")
## attr(,"contrasts")$sex2
## [1] "contr.treatment"
# edgeR differential analysis
y_sex <- estimateDisp(y, design_sex)
fit_sex <- glmQLFit(y_sex, design_sex)

# test male vs female (coef 2)
qlf_sex <- glmQLFTest(fit_sex, coef = 2)

# extract results
res_sex <- topTags(qlf_sex, n = Inf)$table
res_sex <- tibble::rownames_to_column(res_sex, "peak_id")

head(res_sex)

top10_sex <- res_sex %>%
  arrange(PValue) %>%
  slice(1:10)

top10_sex

logcpm_sex <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
mat_sex <- logcpm_sex[top10_sex$peak_id, , drop = FALSE]

anno_col_sex <- cd[, c(stress_col, sex_col), drop = FALSE]
rownames(anno_col_sex) <- colnames(mat_sex)

pheatmap(
  mat_sex,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = anno_col_sex,
  main = "Top 10 sex-associated regions"
)
